author: John. R. Edwardson
title: Apple (AAPL) Lifted to “Buy” at Maxim Group
text:
Posted by John. R. Edwardson on Jun 3rd, 2018 // No Comments
Maxim Group upgraded shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from a hold rating to a buy rating in a report published on Thursday.
Several other equities analysts have also recently issued reports on AAPL. Barclays lowered their price objective on shares of Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an equal weight rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Needham & Company LLC lifted their price objective on shares of Apple to $210.00 and gave the stock a buy rating in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. Morgan Stanley lowered their price objective on shares of Apple from $203.00 to $200.00 and set an overweight rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, April 20th. Bank of America reaffirmed a buy rating and issued a $220.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 23rd. Finally, Vetr raised shares of Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating and set a $184.49 price objective on the stock in a research note on Monday, March 5th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has a consensus rating of Buy and a consensus price target of $205.39. Get Apple alerts:
AAPL stock opened at $190.24 on Thursday. Apple has a 52 week low of $142.20 and a 52 week high of $190.37. The stock has a market cap of $951.38 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 20.66, a P/E/G ratio of 1.39 and a beta of 1.26. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a quick ratio of 1.37 and a current ratio of 1.46. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the firm earned $2.10 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. research analysts expect that Apple will post 11.43 EPS for the current year.
Apple announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to repurchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock repurchase programs are usually a sign that the company’s management believes its shares are undervalued.
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, May 17th. Stockholders of record on Monday, May 14th were paid a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.53%. This is a boost from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, May 11th. Apple’s payout ratio is presently 31.70%.
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 4,867 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, May 16th. The shares were sold at an average price of $187.00, for a total value of $910,129.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,433 shares in the company, valued at $1,576,971. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this link . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 252,084 shares of company stock valued at $44,474,650 over the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.

Marcus Capital LLC now owns 4,342 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $729,000 after purchasing an additional 275 shares during the last quarter. TLP Group LLC now owns 1,385 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $232,000 after purchasing an additional 280 shares during the last quarter. Capital Insight Partners LLC raised its stake in Apple by 4.9% during the 4th quarter. Capital Insight Partners LLC now owns 6,292 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,065,000 after purchasing an additional 293 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Corundum Group Inc. raised its stake in Apple by 15.4% during the 3rd quarter. Corundum Group Inc. now owns 2,242 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $346,000 after purchasing an additional 299 shares during the last quarter.
